description: Scrape public subreddit listings and keep only the posts you want. Reads the live browser feed with a full-field archive fallback and uses RSS only as a last resort. Filter by keywords, score, comments, upvote ratio, age, flair, post type, author, domain, NSFW and stickied status. No login, API key or proxy setup.

authorAllowlist.description: Case-insensitive usernames. Leave empty for any author.
authorAllowlist.sectionDescription: Optional allow and block lists. Self-posts always pass domain filters.
authorAllowlist.title: Only these authors

domainAllowlist.description: Keep posts linking to these domains. Self-posts always pass. Accepts bare domains or URLs.
domainAllowlist.title: Only these link domains

domainBlocklist.description: Drop posts linking to these domains. Self-posts always pass.
domainBlocklist.title: Block these link domains

excludeKeywords.description: Drop posts containing any of these words or phrases.
excludeKeywords.title: Exclude keywords

excludeNsfw.description: Drop posts marked NSFW. NSFW-only communities are hidden anonymously, so this is a per-post filter.
excludeNsfw.title: Exclude NSFW posts

flairAllowlist.description: Case-insensitive exact flair names. Leave empty for any flair.
flairAllowlist.title: Only these post flairs

includeKeywords.description: Keep posts containing at least one of these words or phrases. Matching is case-insensitive.
includeKeywords.sectionDescription: Filters are applied before Max matching posts per subreddit is counted.
includeKeywords.title: Include keywords

includeSubredditInfo.description: Emit one extra record per subreddit with its description, weekly active users and weekly contributions. Adds one request per subreddit.
includeSubredditInfo.sectionDescription: Optional extra output. The post scrape works without it.
includeSubredditInfo.title: Include subreddit info records

keywordMatch.description: Any keyword, all keywords, or the exact phrase formed by joining the include keywords.
keywordMatch.title: Keyword matching

maxAgeDays.description: Shortcut for keeping only recent posts. Posted after can also be used.
maxAgeDays.title: Maximum post age in days

maxComments.description: Drop posts with more comments. Leave empty for no maximum.
maxComments.title: Maximum comments

maxPosts.description: Stop after this many posts pass your filters. The actor keeps paging until it finds them or reaches Reddit's listing limit.
maxPosts.title: Max matching posts per subreddit

maxScore.description: Drop posts with a higher score. Leave empty for no maximum.
maxScore.title: Maximum score

minComments.description: Drop posts with fewer comments. Leave empty for no minimum.
minComments.title: Minimum comments

minScore.description: Drop posts with a lower score. Leave empty for no minimum.
minScore.title: Minimum score

minUpvoteRatio.description: Keep posts with at least this upvote ratio, from 0 to 1. Leave empty for no minimum.
minUpvoteRatio.title: Minimum upvote ratio

postType.description: Keep one post type or all types.
postType.title: Post type

postedAfter.description: ISO date (2026-10-01) or a relative value such as 7 days or 24 hours. Leave empty for no lower bound.
postedAfter.title: Posts created on or after

postedBefore.description: ISO date or a relative value such as 7 days. Leave empty for no upper bound.
postedBefore.title: Posts created on or before

searchIn.description: Search the title, the body, or both.
searchIn.title: Search keywords in

sort.description: How to order posts in each subreddit. Top and controversial use the time filter. If only the archive fallback is available, rows are newest-first.
sort.title: Sort posts by

subreddits.description: Public subreddits to scrape. Accepts names, r/ names or full Reddit URLs.
subreddits.sectionDescription: Pick the communities and how their posts should be ordered.
subreddits.title: Subreddits

timeFilter.description: Time window used when Sort is Top or Controversial. Ignored for other sorts.
timeFilter.title: Time range for top / controversial

title: Reddit Subreddit Post Filter & Moderation Scraper Input
